Subject: Next steps & calendar: technical review for HealTech POC

Hi Mike —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: validate integration surface for real-time inference (latency < 150ms p95) and discuss data handling for PHI-light payloads.
- Requested stakeholders for tech deep dive: HealTech engineering (Sandra, SE), HealTech security (procurement/security), Redwood SE + infra lead.
- Materials: attached mutual action plan (MAP) v1 and a short pre-req checklist (tech-pre-reqs.docx).

Proposed deep-dive windows (in PT):
1) Thu Sep 9 — 10:00–11:00 PT (13:00–14:00 ET)
2) Fri Sep 10 — 08:00–09:00 PT (11:00–12:00 ET)

Can you confirm which slot works best and who will join from your side? Also let us know whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for recording/record retention. If neither, we can send both links in the calendar invite and pick the join link at the start.

If the above looks good I’ll loop in Ben (our solutions engineer) and send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and the MAP link.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Karthik —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Appreciate the clear options. Option 1 (Thu Sep 9, 10:00 PT) works better for us.

Attendees from HealTech:
- Sandra Li (VP Engineering) — will lead architecture questions
- Tom Alvarez (Staff SE) — will own integration details
- procurement@healtech.ai — for intake/contract questions (listed for visibility)

We prefer Zoom so we can record. Please include the Zoom passcode in the invite (we have to collect recordings for compliance).

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs any inbound firewall rules from our side for the demo environment? If so, I’ll loop in infra.

Best,
Mike
Head of Platform — HealTech
